sentences.text:
============
 Appearance:
 MR.MAHEK RAWAL for MR PREMAL S RACHH(3297) for the Applicant(s)
 No. 1,2,3,4  MR KANABHAI M VADHIYA(12543) for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MR.RONAK RAWAL, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1
Date : 06/04/2026  ORAL ORDER 1.

This application is filed for quashment of the FIR being CR No.11202014220145/2022 registered with Dhrol Police Station, District: Jamnagar for the offence punishable under section 498-A, 323,
114 of IPC.
2.

At the outset, learned advocate for the complainant has placed on record the affidavit of the first informant which is reproduced hereinbelow:
"I, Meghna Brijesh Makwana, aged 29 years, Residing at: B-504, 9th Avenue,
Nanavati Chowk, Rajkot - 360007, respondent No. 2 herein, do hereby on solemn affirmation state as under:
Punamben Pravinbhai Makwana vs State Of Gujarat on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111779902/
1 1.

sentences.text: I state that I have been read over and explained the contents of the captioned petition and am therefore conversant with the facts of the present case.

I state that I am the original complainant in FIR No. 1120201422014 of 2022 registered with Dhrol Police Station for NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7337/2022 ORDER DATED: 06/04/2026 undefined the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. I state and submit that after the filing of the aforesaid FIR, with the intervention of family members, elders and well-wishers, the disputes and differences that had arisen between me and my husband have now been amicably resolved.
3.I state that I and my husband have mutually decided to put an end to all disputes and have resumed cohabitation.
We have decided to live together peacefully and lead a harmonious matrimonial life.
All misunderstandings and grievances now stand fully settled between us.

4. I state that in view of the aforesaid settlement, I do not wish to pursue the aforesaid complaint/FIR any further and I have no objection if the same is quashed and set aside by this Hon'ble Court.
5.
I further state that this affidavit is being executed by me out of my own free will and volition, without any force, coercion, undue influence or pressure from any person whatsoever.
6. In view of the above, the Hon'ble Court is humbly requested to pass appropriate orders in the interest of justice.
7. I further state that the contents of the present affidavit have also been read over and explained to me in Gujarati."
3. In view of above affidavit, learned advocate Mr.Kanabhai Vadhiya submits that if impugned FIR is quashed he would not have any objection.
The presence of the complainant is noted.

4. Having heard the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, considering the facts and circumstances arising out of the present application as NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7337/2022 ORDER DATED: 06/04/2026 undefined well as taking into consideration the decisions rendered by the Apex Court in the cases of 'Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr.', reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, 'Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab', reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, 'Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr.', reported in 2009 (1) GLH 31, 'Manoj Sharma Vs. State &
Ors.', reported in 2009 (1) GLH 190 and 'Narinder Singh & Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Anr.', reported in 2014 (2) Crime 67 (SC), it appears that further continuation of criminal proceedings in relation to the impugned FIR against the applicant would be unnecessary harassment to the applicant.

sentences.text: Considering the nature of disputes between the parties which are all private in nature, I am of the opinion that the matter requires consideration.

It appears that the trial would be futile and further NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7337/2022 ORDER DATED: 06/04/2026 undefined continuance of the proceedings pursuant to the impugned FIR would amount to abuse of process of law and hence, to secure the ends of justice, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside in exercise of powers conferred under Section 482 of the Code.
5.
In view of the above, this application is allowed.
The impugned FIR being CR No.11202014220145/2022 registered with Dhrol Police Station, District: Jamnagar as well as all consequential proceedings are hereby quashed and set aside.
